comment: Whack-A-Reporter dialogue. Edit text here, then run tools/tts_pipeline.py (Piper neural TTS) to regenerate WAVs. 'qa' pairs drive gameplay: reporter asks the question when popping up; if bonked the president speaks the answer.

prez_start.speaker: president
prez_start.text:
Welcome, welcome. This press briefing is about me, 
the greatest president, possibly of all time.
 Keep your questions short, wrong, and unasked.

prez_over.speaker: president
prez_over.text:
Impeached? I am being impeached bigly. 
This is the most unfair thing since my golf handicap.

prez_won.speaker: president
prez_won.text:
Four more years! The reporters are gone and I answered nothing. 
A perfect term.

prez_taunt1.speaker: president
prez_taunt1.text: Nobody dodges questions better than me. Everybody says so.

prez_level2.speaker: president
prez_level2.text: They are moving now? Tremendous cowards. Sad!

question.speaker: reporter1
question.text: Mister President, why were classified documents found in your golf bag?

answer.speaker: president
answer.text:
Those were my scorecards. Very classified scorecards. 
Nobody shoots a sixty-eight like me.

question.speaker: reporter2
question.text: Sir, the economy shrank by nine percent this quarter. Your comment?

answer.speaker: president
answer.text: Wrong. It grew by minus nine percent. That is growth. Look it up, sweetheart.

question.speaker: reporter1
question.text: Scientists say the climate report is alarming. Have you read it?

answer.speaker: president
answer.text: I never read alarming things. That is how I stay so incredibly calm and handsome.

question.speaker: reporter2
question.text: Your new healthcare plan appears to be a coupon for soup. Elaborate?

answer.speaker: president
answer.text: It is beautiful soup. Very affordable. The finest soup-based healthcare in the world.

question.speaker: reporter1
question.text: The ethics committee says you fired the entire ethics committee. True?

answer.speaker: president
answer.text: There is no ethics committee, so who is asking? Exactly. Next question.

question.speaker: reporter2
question.text: Polls show ninety percent of citizens disapprove of your performance.

answer.speaker: president
answer.text:
Fake polls. My internal numbers show one hundred and ten percent approval. 
Tremendous math.

question.speaker: reporter1
question.text: Why does your cousin with no banking experience run the treasury?

answer.speaker: president
answer.text:
Kevin is family. Family is trust. Trust is money. The treasury is money. 
It is all connected.

question.speaker: reporter2
question.text: Can you explain the missing forty billion dollars from the budget?

answer.speaker: president
answer.text:
It is not missing. It is exploring. Money needs freedom. 
That is called capitalism.
